method: Rehydrate to fresh directories, initialize Git, locally set core.autocrlf=true, stage with empty per-command global excludes/attributes files, compare original index trees, recheck all working-file sizes and SHA-256 values.
limits: This verifies fixture recovery, not a new model execution.
An earlier helper attempt with raw Git check-in and core.autocrlf=false correctly produced a different index tree; working bytes and index normalization are distinct checks.
